# R2.12 — IFC residual: the `labels_leaves` per-leaf admission walk, the remedy consume path through the durable ingress, and the produce-time `FlowInputs.shape_endorsed` stamp

Ticket `docs/tickets/118_R2.12__ifc-residual.md`
(seq 118). Stacked on `svitali/harnessharness-r2.11` (PR #118);
ADR-0344. Offline-only: every cell is `fixture`-verified — no
live/staging environment, no production mutation.

**Requirement ids:** DF-S2.7-1 · BL-20 · R-2.8.2.

## What landed

**The `labels_leaves` per-leaf admission walk (member a; ADR-0344
D1).** `hh-env::leaf_admission::walk_result_leaves` enumerates the
shaped `structured_result`'s leaf positions against the declared
`output_schema` — the OQ-219 admitted-keyword subset shared with
`conforms` (CC1), recursing `properties`/`items`/
`additionalProperties:<schema>`, bounded at 1024 leaves / depth 64.
Every leaf records `{path, admission, label}` on
`context.observation.recorded{leaves[]}` — structural positions, never
result bytes; a `labels_leaves = false` contract mints the pre-R2.12
row byte-identically (absent-not-null). A non-admissible leaf —
uncovered member/element, unchecked keyword, missing or malformed
shaped result, budget overflow — refuses typed
`observed{status: error{conflict{admission_leaf:*}}}` +
`recorded{admission: leaf_refused, leaf}`: post-`committed`
`action.effect.refused` is lifecycle-illegal, so the refusal rides the
observation plane's error channel with the `label` member honestly
absent.

**The remedy consume path (member b; ADR-0344 D5).**
`PermissionOutcome::Remedy` joins the boundary sum (schema artifacts
regenerated, CC7); both `respond_permission` paths decode the closed
`Remedy` sum (`malformed_remedy:*` on a bad decode) and gate membership
against the durable `pending.request.remedies` offer
(`OptionNotOffered`). `ResponseChoice::Remedy` is a *deciding*
response — the same principal/`ApproverGrant` legitimacy gate
`allow*`/`modify` answer: `approval{effect_id}` decides `allow` (I-F6
R4, `scope = once`); every other kind decides `deny{reason:
remedy:<kind>}` — terminal, re-enter under the attestation (ADR-0343
D1's shape). `decided{remedy_taken}` is the durable consume
attestation; `DispatchInput.remedy_taken` re-dispatches verified
against it (`remedy_not_attested:*` when no decided row carries the
canonically-identical take) and exactly-once against other effects'
`authorized{remedy_taken}` (`remedy_replayed:*`); `authorized`
restates the take — durable rows both sides. The egress respond path
applies the same arms.

**The produce-time `shape_endorsed` stamp (member c; ADR-0344
D2–D4).** A `shape_endorse` take mints `action.param.anchored` — the
new durable class carrying the param's own label as provenance (the
endorsement's honest `from`; non-audit so the stamp never fabricates
kernel authority) — then `security.label.endorsed{basis: validator,
capacity_bits ≤ cap_max, robustness_inputs, subject_ref: <anchor>}`,
anchor first so the append-time `subject_ref` check resolves over the
committed prefix. The take's flow effect is kernel-stamped on the
proposal: `param_labels[param]` lifts to the endorsed `to` label and
`param` enters `shape_endorsed` — the durable row attests the rise,
never a caller claim, and the observation's `L(r)` reads the same
stamped inputs. `shape_endorsed_params(events, args_canonical_hash)`
folds durable `validator`-basis endorsements into
`FlowInputs.shape_endorsed` **args-scoped** — the row's `subject_ref`
must resolve to an anchor whose `args_canonical_hash` equals this
dispatch's (an endorsement never launders across re-supplied args),
and `capacity_bits ≤ cap_max` is re-checked (the record is the
authority). A take that cannot mint its endorsement — unbounded
schema, over `cap_max`, non-`external` subject, `NoLabelIncrease` —
refuses `remedy_inapplicable:*` rather than recording a
take-with-no-effect.

**Supporting schema/ledger changes.** `hh-ledger` registers
`action.param.anchored` (durable, provenance-required, non-audit;
hosted lowering `hint`) and admits `remedy_taken` on the audit-grade
`action.effect.authorized` partition (`decided` already carried it).
`hh-embed-schema` gains `PermissionOutcome.remedy` — the generated
client + schema artifacts regenerated.

**DF/BL dispositions.** DF-S2.7-1 → DONE (all three members landed —
dated marker on the row). BL-20 → closed (see BACKLOG).

## Tests (fail-if-removed)

- `crates/hh-env/tests/r2_12.rs` — 10 cells: every-leaf records +
  `as_declared`/`unverified` kinds; uncovered-leaf typed refusal
  (`admission_leaf:uncovered:/extra`, `leaf_refused`, no post-commit
  `refused`); unchecked-keyword and no-shaped-result refusals;
  `labels_leaves = false` byte-identical; unattested take →
  `remedy_not_attested`; attested take → `authorized{remedy_taken}`;
  replay → `remedy_replayed`; `shape_endorse` mints anchor + endorsed
  (`subject_ref` = anchor, `capacity_bits`, args-scoped fold — a
  different args hash discharges nothing); inapplicable take →
  `remedy_inapplicable`, no endorsement minted.
- `crates/hh-embed/tests/r2_12.rs` — 4 cells: `remedy` outcome mints
  `decided{deny, reason: remedy:sanitize, remedy_taken}` + the
  `remedies` echo and idempotent replay; `approval{effect_id}` take
  decides `allow`; unoffered/no-offer remedy → `OptionNotOffered`,
  no decided row; malformed remedy → `SchemaViolation`.
